data.gender_notes: Bahlul is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bahlul is derived from the Arabic word 'bahl', which means 'deep' or 'trust'. This name signifies a deep trust and reliance on Allah. The name Bahlul carries the meaning “Trust in Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bahlul usually hope their child will grow to embody trust in allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of deep faith and trust in Allah.
data.etymology: Bahlul belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trust in Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bahlul total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
